title: Choose u and dv
text: Let $$u={\ln\left(x\right)}^2$$ and $$dv=dx$$, so $$du=\frac{2\ln\left(x\right)}{x} dx$$ and $$v=x$$. This gives $$x {\ln\left(x\right)}^2$$ minus the integral of $$2\ln\left(x\right)$$.

title: Finish the integral
text: The integral of ln(x) is $$x \ln\left(x\right)-x$$, so the integral of $$2\ln\left(x\right)$$ is $$2x \ln\left(x\right)-2x$$.
